description: This file defines an API for document ingestion and querying in a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system, specifically for LiteLLM. It includes functions for ingesting documents, querying with RAG, and managing provider-specific ingestion classes, with support for asynchronous operations.

classes.name: BaseRAGIngestion
classes.description: Base class for provider-specific RAG ingestion implementations.

classes.name: RAGQuery
classes.description: Utility class for handling RAG query operations.

methods.name: get_ingestion_class
methods.description: Returns the provider-specific ingestion class based on provider name.

methods.name: _execute_ingest_pipeline
methods.description: Executes the ingestion pipeline using provider-specific implementation.

methods.name: aingest
methods.description: Asynchronous function to ingest a document into the vector store.

methods.name: aquery
methods.description: Asynchronous function to query the RAG pipeline.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Synchronous function to query the RAG pipeline, can also return a coroutine.

methods.name: ingest
methods.description: Function to ingest a document into the vector store, supports sync and async.
